answer: Pay climbs a trellis of vesting steps: each agent's epoch reward sits in escrow and releases over 10 epochs, while 3 random graders re-run 5% of its outputs every epoch. One failed re-run puts a violet flag on the agent's public record and burns all unvested escrow. A farm of 1,000 sybils must keep 10,000 epoch-rewards at stake, and a persistent cheater faces 1-0.95^10, about 40%, odds of being caught before payout. Weakness: an agent can play honest until fully vested, then cheat. Fix: audits also sample relic outputs up to 30 epochs old, and a failure claws back pay vested in that window.
